name: the engaging pass measures before it sets html.mb-sph-on
why: The ported 9.99.1167 order, restored: offsets are read while <body> still has its disengaged margins, then the class lands and moves everything by them. Self-corrects only when a ResizeObserver round-trip triggers a second pass, so only a test that reads the engaging pass itself can see it; the settle-based tests cannot.

name: the collapsed sidebar's transform is kept while engaged
why: KNOWN BLIND SPOT, live-only. WIP.2: on the real page #page is display: table and #sidebar its right-hand cell, so translateX(100%) leaves a ghost box (and a dead scroll area) past the end of #page, and every bar is dragged along during the last part of the scroll. The fixtures load WITHOUT MusicBrainz's stylesheet: measured 2026-10-02, the collapsed #sidebar is then a 0-width display: block box BELOW #content (rect.right 10, document scrollWidth unchanged by the transform), so the ghost cannot exist and no fixture assertion can see this guard. name: <body>'s margins are not zeroed while engaged
why: WIP.2: while engaged <body> is fit-content wide; with its own margins left in place (8px UA, or MB's margin: auto) it does not shrink back to the viewport once the overflow is gone. Caught by the ratchet test only (measured per test, 2026-10-02): the pinning tests stay green because every offset is derived from the same, consistently shifted geometry.
grep: no ratchet

name: every ResizeObserver notification schedules a refresh again
why: The ported behaviour before WIP.4: height-only notifications (a sort re-appending rows) each schedule a pass that forces a layout of the whole table. Measured on artist-events: 4-7 passes per sort, up to 253 ms.
grep: a sort triggers no refresh pass

name: the width gate drops every notification
why: Over-correction guard: a gate that never schedules would also pass the "no pass on sort" half; the positive control (a table getting wider) must catch it.

name: focus anywhere in a bar raises it again
why: The ported rule before WIP.4: plain :focus-within. The global filter is focused after every render, so the data h2 sat at z-index 107 and painted over a vertically sticky MB header.
grep: stacking while the global filter has focus

name: focus never raises a bar

name: the custom properties are no longer registered non-inherited
why: Unregistered custom properties inherit: one write on <body> or a bar restyles its whole subtree (the original write on <html> cost a 249 ms full-document recalc on 4174 rows).

name: section bodies are not collected
why: The content of an expanded Credits / Annotation / Relationships section scrolls away under its pinned bar again: the state the feature shipped in (reported 2026-10-03, release 5cf63c93-...).

name: hidden section bodies are not observed
why: Expanding a collapsed section changes no other observed WIDTH, so the width-only gate lets nothing through and the newly shown body is only pinned by whatever pass happens next (a resize, a horizontal scroll from scrollX 0). The expand test polls without scrolling or resizing.

name: every table.tbl guard on section bodies is removed
why: Three guards keep data tables scrolling: the data h2 is skipped, a sibling that is/contains table.tbl is skipped, and _sphIsEligible() rejects one for a body. They back each other up, so removing one alone is invisible BY DESIGN; removing all three must pin a data table (series-releases: its table.tbl follows the data h2 directly).
